title: Does Time Cause Gravity?
summary: PBS Space Time explores whether time causes gravity, explaining that gravity does not truly warp the flow of time but arises from time gradients. It revisits how gravitational time dilation works in general relativity.
why: Recommended as a good explanation of what happens when gravity acts on an object.

quote.text: Here's a really good explanation of what's actually going on when gravity influences an object.
